archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / HIGH DENSITY EXECUTIVE SAAS

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

landing_page.hero: Split screen or bold center headline with high-contrast badge: 'PRACTICE NEGOTIATIONS. NOT JUST THEORY.'
landing_page.problem_section: 3-column comparison grid (Traditional Training vs Generic AI vs NEGOTIA Real-time Simulator)
landing_page.how_it_works: 4-step animated timeline: 1. Select Scenario -> 2. Prep Strategy & BATNA -> 3. Multi-Opponent Simulation -> 4. AI Debrief & Radar Score
landing_page.features: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid) highlighting Voice/Text mode, Tactical Coaching, Harvard/SPIN analytics, and Replay Engine
landing_page.scenario_showcase: Interactive carousel or grid showcasing Enterprise M&A, Salary Negotiation, Vendor Contract, Crisis Management
landing_page.methodology: Card layout detailing Harvard Principled Negotiation, BATNA Calculator, SPIN Questioning Framework
landing_page.cta: High-impact CTA block with immediate 'Start Free Simulation' trigger

dashboard.welcome_bar: Personalized greeting, current streak counter, quick '+ New Simulation' primary CTA button
dashboard.stats_grid: 4 key KPI widgets: Total Sims, Avg Outcome Score %, Highest Deal Value / Win %, Active Streak Days
dashboard.skills_radar: Recharts Radar Chart displaying 6 core competencies: Questioning, Listening, Argumentation, Concessions, BATNA Management, Conflict Resolution
dashboard.recent_simulations: Data table with scenario title, opponents, date, score badge, deal status (Agreed / Walkaway / Deadlock), and Replay button
dashboard.recommended_scenario: Feature card with difficulty tag, target skills, estimated duration, and 1-click launch

scenario_library.filters: Category tabs (Corporate M&A, Sales & SPIN, Procurement, HR & Salary, Crisis), Difficulty rating (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Executive), Opponents count (1 to 4)
scenario_library.cards: Rich scenario cards with avatar stack, key objectives, methodology tags, target duration, launch button

steps: 2. Mode Selection (Text & Mic / Multiple Choice / Full Voice)
simulation_wizard.layout: Progress stepper bar with full validation and state persistence

negotiation_room.header_hud: Opponents status bar, Tension Level Meter (0-100%), Deal Value / Terms Bar, Current BATNA Threshold indicator, Pause / Advice button
negotiation_room.opponents_panel: Cards for 1-4 AI opponents showing name, role, current stance (Defensive, Aggressive, Open), mood indicator, and voice waveform if speaking
negotiation_room.chat_canvas: Real-time message feed with clear separation between User and AI opponents, AI thinking state animation ('Analyzing counter-offer...'), inline coaching hints toggle
negotiation_room.input_controls: Tabbed or dynamic switcher: 1) Text Input with Speech-to-Text Microphone button, 2) Tactical Choice Cards (3-4 option cards with risk levels), 3) Voice Call Mode with audio spectrum feedback

debrief_and_history.debrief: Prominent Overall Score (e.g. 84/100) with outcome banner (Agreement Reached / Walkaway Executed), 6-Skill Radar breakdown, 'What You Did Well' (3 points), 'Areas to Improve' (3 points), Critical Decision Moments timeline, and 'Recommended Alternative Path' simulator
debrief_and_history.history: Filterable history log with search, date range, difficulty filter, and full replay export/view
debrief_and_history.profile: User analytics dashboard, skill progression over time, earned negotiation certifications/badges, personal BATNA strengths

i18n_support.implementation_notes: Use structured JSON key-value dictionary hook (e.g. `useTranslation`) for all UI labels, scenario titles, debrief rubrics, and opponent responses to allow seamless multi-language toggling.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, filter pills, inputs, cards, speech toggles) have strict data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use pure default generic chat aesthetics. Treat the Negotiation Room like a live corporate command center HUD.
Implement real working multi-language support (English / Russian) using state/context dictionary toggling in the top header.
Ensure full responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile views with tight spacing padding.
Use Recharts or SVG radar charts for skill breakdown in both Dashboard and Debrief modal/page.
In Negotiation Room, support 3 operational input modes: Text + Voice Mic, Structured Multiple Choice (3 options with impact preview), and Full Interactive Voice call mode simulation.
